cases.name: Kary Jo Dill
cases.about: Her Find a Grave said: "She was kind, generous, fun-loving, quick with a come back, had a smile that wouldn't quit, and was very loyal. If she decided she cared about you, she never stopped. Kary loved her family, friends, kids, and animals. Some of her favorite things were to sing and dance, cook good food, watch butterflies, birds, and horror movies, smell lilacs, eat raspberries and get flowers for no reason. She was scared of spiders and the dark. Kary enjoyed any outdoor activity: camping, four wheeling, hiking, skiing, sitting by a fire and anything in or on the water. Her absolutely "good time" was to go fishing with her dad. There will always be a "Kary's Cove" in Dobsey! Spending time with her brother, being ridiculous in the way only siblings can, made them both happy. She also shared her mothers love of a good book and watching football."
